_meta.description: Event ('Sigil') quest TEMPLATES, keyed by gldQuestId. Capture-derived from the gameEventQuests[] arrays of pre-shutdown /quests and /objectives responses.
_meta.authoritative: objectiveIds, version, rewards[], finalReward — all verbatim from retail responses.
_meta.derivation: Where a template was observed with more than one reward payload (retail rotated the event currency per season) the most-frequently-observed payload is used and the alternatives are kept under _meta.rewardsVariants.
_meta.rewardModel: The Nth completion of an event-quest instance pays rewards[N]; the last one pays rewards[last] + finalReward. Verified against 93 retail instances / 300+ completions.
_meta.payableRewards: The same milestone payouts as observed in the /complete BODY, keyed by completion index. Retail lists the gem currency under stackableItems in rewards[] (what the client displays) and under currencies in /complete (what the server grants); these are the granting form, taken verbatim.
_meta.seasonalEvents: EQ40 Season of the Witch (Halloween) and EQ42 The Long Night (midwinter) are AUTHORED, not capture-derived — they were retired before our corpus begins. Each carries _meta.authored = true and names what it was copied from. Report #189.

_meta.name: EQ40 Season of the Witch
_meta.questResolvedBy: parsed.json quests[] — unique match on BOTH the objective uuid and the dungeon uuid of the APK's quests.json entry for this event
_meta.note: This event was retired before our capture corpus begins, so nothing about its payouts is capture-derived. The whole milestone table — wire rewards, granting tiers and final reward — is copied verbatim from the retail template named in copiedFrom, which carries the modal Sigil ladder (14 of 39 events) and 700 XP a step. Only the quest, the objective and the calendar window are ours. Report #189.
